body: Rich, if Decent Partners is aiming to become a primary onboarding location for new projects at first you should reconsider which projects/ideas truly worth to be funded. If the only criteria to enroll a project to edgeware referendum system is that project representatives showed on several community calls and behaved nicely and additionally you present "a paradigm" that edgeware is an experimental chain/playground without any added value then I vote no. This model has to change, this simply doesn't work anymore.
